messages:
Maya: Noticed a creeping increase in 'stranded tiny pods' in eu-west1 after we enabled rack-agnostic packing for mini-batches. They're mostly showing NodeAffinity mismatch evictions after scheduling.
Ravi: hmm do you have a sample describe? could be label mismatch between scheduler expectations and node labels.
Maya: saw this in describe:

```
Events:
  Type     Reason             Age   From               Message
  ----     ------             ----  ----               -------
  Warning  FailedScheduling   4m    default-scheduler  0/64 nodes are available: 15 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu, 8 too many of requested nic attachments, 40 node(s) had untolerated taint.
  Normal   Scheduled          3m    default-scheduler  Successfully assigned default/mini-batch-9 to rack-22-node-09
  Normal   Started            2m    kubelet            Started container
  Warning  Evicted           30s   eviction-controller  NodeAffinity mismatch -> Evicted
```

Ravi: NodeAffinity mismatch after start suggests a node label change during bootstrap (e.g., warmnode label removal on kubelet restart) or API server race with Cordon/Drain.
ops-bot: node/rack-22-node-09 cordoned by auto-ops (reason: thermal-pressure) at 1778879945
Maya: that auto-ops cordon lines up. So scheduler picks node, pod starts, then auto-ops cordon -> eviction. That explains the pattern.
Ravi: root cause hypothesis: our auto-ops thermal detector is too sensitive for mini-batch workloads. It cordons entire nodes aggressively on transient CPU spikes; we should make it prefer drain with graceful threshold for tiny pods.
Maya: mitigation: 1) tune auto-ops to not cordon nodes for thermal events under 30s, 2) add a preemptible graceful window for tiny pods (delay eviction 15s to let attach finalize), 3) scheduler to prefer nodes with 'stable' label that auto-ops sets after 5m of no cordon events.
Ravi: +1. Also we should add a metric to track 'cordon-after-schedule' evictions so we can alert before it gets noisy.
deploy-bot: auto-ops/config rolled (therm_cordon_min_duration=30s) in eu-west1 (deploy id: d-2026-0510-03) :white_check_mark:
Maya: after the change, 'NodeAffinity mismatch' evictions for mini-batch dropped from ~5/min to ~0.7/min over 20m. Looks promising.
Ravi: follow-up PRs: auto-ops tuning (min duration), scheduler 'stable' label scoring, and eviction delay for tiny pods. I'll own the eviction delay PR.
Maya: tagging capacity and hardware teams to investigate thermal blips and see if some racks have faulty fans. Leaving thread for PR links and follow-ups. :raised_hands:
